entry.name: Elderroot Balm
entry.notes: atom.mending Flat current-HP top-up on grant; high band -- the deepest, slowest-grown root stock, reserved for when a quick top-up is not enough.

entry.name: Steadfast Distillate
entry.notes: Crit-resist stat.derived family (combat.crit.resist.*); run-scoped binding at dispatch, same discipline as k2's other stat.derived draughts.

entry.name: Anvilcore Ward
entry.notes: Shield-toughness stat.derived family (combat.shield.toughness.*); depleting absorption layer bound at battle setup, same discipline as k3's own elemental-defense/resilience wards.
